scope: Unmodified generated pedestrian populations observed with zero movement input for 15 simulation seconds at module 1 per stage (four 1/60-second ticks per rendered frame), plus isolated legacy action mechanism fixtures. Hotspot observer starts and subsequent task/quiet-loop views are explicitly arranged; only the observer is relocated for comparison views, with no further Tick or NPC changes. Each population screenshot records its actual camera center and unchanged gameplay zoom. Accelerated simulation is NOT an FPS/performance test, complete-route evidence, or human playtest.
